new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Title:** Plant Manager

**FLSA:** Exempt

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Job Overview:**

The primary responsibilities include managing all day-to-day plant operations. Manage and lead a team of production and warehouse employees. Responsible to improve efficiency, cost, quality, and safety through both individual and team contributions.

**Essential Responsibilities**:

* Supervise all plant operations including production and warehouse departments.
* Coordinate departmental activities to fulfill sales orders, meet inventory requirements and deliver manufactured products in a timely fashion.
* Manage staff, prepare work schedules, and assign specific duties in production. Establish and implement departmental policies, goals, objectives, and procedures, conferring with other department directors as necessary.
* Maintains communication and coaching to employees on a daily basis to ensure they have the information to do their jobs and that they understand and adhere to the goals and direction of the company.
* Trains direct reports on operating procedures, quality standards, environmental, health and safety procedures, and company policies. Ensures compliance and sustainment of training to ensure a smooth operation.
* Determine staffing requirements, and participate in the recruiting process i.e., interview, hire and train new employees.
* Provides performance and daily corrective feedback to employees as needed. Writes direct reports performance reviews. Recommends raises next level of discipline and terminations to Director of Operations and Human Resources Manager.
* Respond to emergency department requests. Troubleshoot issues to determine cause and solution.
* Participate in all shifts as necessary to assure the department is streamlined.
* Collaborates with other departments on projects as needed.
* Communicate regularly with plant personnel to maintain a high level of morale.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Familiarity with manufacturing environments, and ability to apply fundamental troubleshooting skills to technical problems.
* Familiarity with Continuous Improvement, LEAN, and six-sigma.
* Familiarity with meeting OSHA standards and leading a culture of safety first.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities, identify and addresses problems and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively with a wide array of personnel.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Computer skills to include ERP system and Microsoft programs. Must be able to use computer programs to keep track of administrative tasks such as report writing, analysis of work orders, evaluations of production estimates and outputs.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to talk with groups of employees as well as strong one-on-one communication skills to facilitate employee engagement.
* Must be committed to the success of the entire organization.

**Physical Requirements:**

Requirements include, but are not limited to:

* Works in both an office environment and a warehouse.
* Requires sitting, operating a computer keyboard, telephone, and other office equipment for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to stand and walk for prolonged periods of time as required to the walk-shop floor.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Must be able to perform repetitive motions such as reaching and grasping.

* The work environment is in a warehouse/production and temperatures inside vary between hot and cold based on the outside conditions.
* This is a fast-paced environment with constantly changing priorities.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field required.
* 10+ years leading a team in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in the plastic bottle industry, or in a manufacturing environment, is highly preferred
* Must be "hands-on" and assist in completing department goals as required.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance premium.
* Employer-paid Life Insurance
* Employer Match
* Paid Vacation and Paid Sick
* Holiday Pay

***We are an Equal Opportunity/ Affirmative Action Employer and do not discriminate against applicants due to veteran status, disability, race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or other protected characteristics.***

new_roles.title: VP Supply Chain and Operations
new_roles.description:
Vice President of Global Supply Chain and Operations

**Location:** Greater Phoenix, Arizona (On-site)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**Base Salary:** $180,000–$220,000

**Additional Compensation:** 30% annual bonus and equity opportunity

**Travel:** Approximately 30–40%, including international travel

**Relocation Assistance Available**

Position Overview

Seeking an accomplished supply chain and operations executive to lead an expanding domestic and international manufacturing and distribution operation.

This individual will be responsible for developing a scalable, efficient and commercially successful supply chain that supports significant business growth while maintaining exceptional product quality, customer satisfaction and profitability.

The ideal candidate combines executive leadership capabilities with an engineering foundation, extensive outsourced manufacturing experience, strong financial and commercial acumen, and a willingness to remain actively involved in operational execution.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment and enjoys building teams, improving processes, solving complex manufacturing challenges and establishing the operational infrastructure necessary to support rapid expansion.

Experience within packaging, foodservice products, consumer goods or other regulated manufacturing environments is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

**Manufacturing and Supplier Management**

* Direct a geographically distributed network of third-party manufacturing and production partners.
* Evaluate, qualify and develop suppliers based on manufacturing capabilities, quality, capacity, financial performance and service levels.
* Oversee supplier agreements, commercial relationships, pricing negotiations and performance improvement initiatives.
* Incorporate additional manufacturing facilities and production partners into the existing supply chain.
* Establish consistent supplier performance standards, accountability measures and operating procedures.

**Financial Performance and Cost Optimization**

* Develop strategies to improve gross margins, reduce manufacturing expenses and maximize operational efficiency.
* Create detailed manufacturing cost models and should-cost analyses to support supplier negotiations, commercial decisions and customer pricing.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through sourcing strategies, production efficiencies, transportation optimization and inventory management.
* Partner with commercial and financial leadership to align operational decisions with business objectives.
* Improve working capital utilization while maintaining appropriate service levels.

**Supply Chain Planning and Customer Fulfillment**

* Oversee the complete fulfillment process, from demand forecasting and production scheduling through final customer delivery.
* Establish and manage an effective Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) program.
* Ensure customer delivery commitments, product specifications and quality expectations are consistently achieved.
* Coordinate manufacturing capacity, inventory availability and production requirements with internal and external stakeholders.
* Develop strategies to minimize supply disruptions and improve supply chain reliability.
* Manage inventory performance, distribution operations and third-party logistics providers.

**Engineering, Product Launches and Manufacturing Readiness**

* Collaborate with engineering, product development and manufacturing teams to successfully transition new products into commercial production.
* Provide oversight of manufacturing feasibility, tooling development, production validation and supplier readiness.
* Ensure technical documentation, engineering specifications, drawings and bills of materials are properly maintained.
* Establish consistent product qualification and production approval procedures across manufacturing partners.
* Lead suppliers through technical, regulatory and customer approval requirements.

**Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance**

* Establish and maintain effective supplier quality management programs.
* Oversee manufacturing partner assessments, process audits, corrective actions and continuous improvement efforts.
* Ensure products satisfy applicable food-contact regulations, customer requirements and industry standards.
* Coordinate product testing, qualification and independent certification activities.
* Drive systematic resolution of manufacturing defects, customer complaints and recurring quality issues.

**Transportation and International Logistics**

* Manage domestic and international transportation, freight providers and distribution relationships.
* Optimize transportation costs, delivery performance and logistics processes.
* Oversee cross-border shipments, customs documentation and import/export compliance.
* Ensure effective coordination between manufacturing partners, warehouse operations and transportation providers.

**Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Analytics**

* Advance the organization's use of ERP systems, supply chain planning applications and operational reporting.
* Leverage artificial intelligence, intelligent agents and workflow automation to improve productivity and operational decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities involving supplier communications, purchasing, order visibility, quality documentation and performance reporting.
* Apply predictive analytics and data-driven methodologies to demand forecasting, manufacturing cost analysis and supplier evaluation.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure data integrity, information security and human oversight of AI-enabled processes.
* Promote adoption of emerging technologies throughout the operations organization.

**Executive Leadership and Organizational Development**

* Lead, mentor and expand a multidisciplinary supply chain and operations team.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operational metrics and individual accountability.
* Build processes and organizational capabilities that can support substantial business growth.
* Develop strong working relationships across sales, finance, engineering, product development and executive leadership.
* Serve as a trusted operational leader for strategic customers and manufacturing partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in supply chain management, manufacturing or operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated leadership of a substantial, multi-location outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing or co-manufacturing operation.
* Proven ability to negotiate complex manufacturing agreements, supplier pricing and measurable cost improvements.
* Experience developing manufacturing cost structures, should-cost models and product profitability analyses.
* Demonstrated success improving gross margins, operational efficiency and working capital performance.
* Experience supporting major customers within quick-service restaurants (QSR), large retail organizations or consumer packaged goods (CPG).
* Direct experience managing manufacturing partners or suppliers located in Mexico.
* Strong knowledge of demand planning, production planning, S&OP, inventory management, warehousing and third-party logistics.
* Experience managing international freight, customs requirements and cross-border supply chain operations.
* Understanding of quality management and regulatory requirements associated with food packaging or food manufacturing.
* Experience with applicable FDA requirements, SQF, BRCGS or comparable quality and food safety standards.
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline. Packaging engineering is preferred; mechanical, industrial, chemical, paper science or related engineering disciplines will be considered.
* Strong technical understanding of the product development and manufacturing lifecycle, including engineering specifications, tooling, production processes and product qualification.
* Experience with supplier qualification, First Article Inspection (FAI), manufacturing process validation, control plans and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) or equivalent methodologies.
* Familiarity with quality engineering methodologies, including PFMEA, SPC, structured root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA).
* Experience coordinating customer product approvals, regulatory testing and third-party product certifications.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop and lead high-performing teams.
* Practical experience applying AI-powered tools, intelligent agents or automated workflows to business operations.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or redesigning an operational workflow using AI or automation.
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience using operational data to guide business decisions.
* Experience with NetSuite ERP.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within fiber-based packaging, paper products, sustainable packaging, foodservice packaging or disposable consumer products.
* Experience overseeing outsourced manufacturing operations with annual spend or revenue approaching or exceeding $100 million.
* Professional proficiency in Spanish.
* Certified Packaging Professional (CPP) or a related technical credential.
* Familiarity with packaging conversion, fiber-forming technologies, surface treatments or similar manufacturing processes.
* Experience within a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial, venture-backed or private equity-backed organization.
* Previous involvement in launching manufacturing facilities or integrating new production partners.
* APICS/ASCM certifications, including CPIM or CSCP.
* Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma training or certification.

Ideal Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be:

* A hands-on executive who takes personal accountability for operational and customer outcomes.
* An entrepreneurial leader who is comfortable operating in a rapidly evolving business environment.
* A commercially oriented decision-maker who understands the relationship between manufacturing costs, revenue, profitability and cash flow.
* A strong negotiator capable of developing productive, long-term supplier relationships.
* A technically credible leader who can engage directly with engineers, manufacturing personnel and quality professionals.
* A resourceful problem-solver who remains composed when faced with competing priorities or demanding customer expectations.
* An organizational builder who introduces structure and discipline without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* A technology-forward executive who recognizes the practical value of AI, automation and advanced analytics.
* An effective communicator capable of influencing stakeholders across different functions, organizations and cultures.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual base salary of $180,000–$220,000, depending on qualifications and experience.
* Annual performance bonus opportunity of 30%.
* Equity or long-term incentive participation.
* Company-paid health and life insurance benefits.
* Relocation assistance for qualified candidates.
* Opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a growing organization.

This position requires regular on-site attendance in the Greater Phoenix area and approximately 30–40% domestic and international travel.

Pay: $180,000.00 - $220,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance

Application Question(s):

* Have you directly managed a multi-site contract manufacturing network?
* Do you have experience in food-contact packaging or food manufacturing?
* Have you implemented an AI-enabled or automated operational workflow?
* How many years of supply chain or manufacturing operations experience do you have?
* Have you developed should-cost models and negotiated manufacturing costs?

Ability to Relocate:

* Phoenix, AZ 85018: Relocate with an employer provided relocation package (Required)

new_roles.title: VP, Supply Chain & Manufacturing Operations - Santa Clara, CA - Hybrid
new_roles.description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations. 
 
The VP, Supply Chain & Manufacturing Operations leads the strategy and execution of Gigamon’s global supply chain and manufacturing operations. This executive oversees planning, procurement, supplier management, manufacturing, logistics, and operational execution to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality products to customers worldwide. The role partners closely with Engineering, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Customer Support to align operational capabilities with business priorities and product growth. Through disciplined execution, risk management, and continuous improvement, this leader strengthens scalability, resilience, and customer satisfaction. 
 
What you’ll do:

* Define and execute a global supply chain and manufacturing strategy aligned with Gigamon’s business objectives, product roadmap, and customer requirements.
* Lead demand and supply planning, materials management, procurement, contract manufacturing, production scheduling, inventory optimization, order fulfillment, logistics, and distribution.
* Establish scalable operating processes, systems, metrics, and governance to improve forecast accuracy, capacity utilization, delivery performance, inventory turns, cost, and working capital.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, suppliers, logistics providers, and other key partners.
* Drive supplier selection, qualification, performance management, capacity planning, commercial negotiations, and continuity planning.
* Build resilience across the supply chain by identifying operational risks, developing contingency plans, and ensuring effective responses to disruptions.
* Partner with Engineering and Product teams on new product introduction, product lifecycle management, design-for-manufacturability, component strategy, and engineering change control.
* Collaborate with Quality and Engineering to establish and maintain product, supplier, and manufacturing quality standards.
* Oversee global manufacturing and fulfillment operations to ensure products are delivered on time, at the required quality level, and in accordance with customer and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure compliance across global trade, tariffs, export controls, environmental requirements, and product regulations, including country-specific certifications and regulatory approvals, in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Quality, and relevant teams.
* Manage reverse-logistics operations, including customer returns and repair; oversee return-material-authorization (RMA) processes and the performance of repair providers and other service partners.
* Lead cross-functional efforts to improve operational efficiency, reduce complexity, and optimize total cost of ownership.
* Oversee product-cost and inventory governance, including standard-cost reviews, bill-of-materials (BOM) cost changes, purchase-price variance (PPV), and excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, in partnership with Finance.
* Establish clear performance expectations and develop a high-performing, globally distributed operations organization.
* Provide executive-level reporting, recommendations, and accountability for supply chain and manufacturing performance.

What you’ve done:

* Led global supply chain, manufacturing, and operations organizations in a technology, networking, telecommunications, electronics, or similarly complex product environment.
* Developed and executed supply chain strategies supporting global customers, multiple product lines, and evolving demand profiles.
* Managed outsourced manufacturing models, including contract manufacturer relationships, supplier networks, production capacity, and end-to-end fulfillment.
* Built expertise across demand planning, supply planning, procurement, inventory management, logistics, manufacturing operations, and supplier performance.
* Delivered measurable improvements in service levels, forecast accuracy, inventory turns, cost, quality, cycle time, or working capital.
* Led successful new product introductions and product transitions in partnership with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Finance.
* Implemented operating mechanisms, systems, analytics, and performance metrics that improved visibility and decision-making across the supply chain.
* Managed significant operational risk, including supplier concentration, component availability, capacity constraints, geopolitical disruption, and business continuity.
* Negotiated and managed strategic supplier and manufacturing agreements with an understanding of commercial, operational, and quality considerations.
* Built, developed, and led high-performing global teams through growth, transformation, and organizational change.
* Demonstrated experience presenting operational performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Held a bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, business, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.

Who you are:

* A strategic and hands-on operations leader who connects long-term business objectives with disciplined day-to-day execution.
* A customer-focused partner who understands how supply chain performance affects product availability, customer experience, and business growth.
* A data-driven decision-maker who uses operational metrics, financial insight, and sound judgment to prioritize action.
* A collaborative executive who builds trust across Engineering, Product, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Customer Support.
* An effective communicator who can translate complex operational issues into clear decisions, priorities, and accountability.
* A resilient and adaptable leader who anticipates risk, responds decisively to disruption, and drives continuous improvement.
* A talent developer who establishes high standards, empowers teams, and creates an inclusive environment where people can perform at their best.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.title: Head of Operations / COO
new_roles.description:
### **About the Role**

A seed-stage AI company serving manufacturers is hiring a Head of Operations / COO to own day-to-day business operations. Working closely with the founders, you will connect customer delivery, supplier and freight operations, and product priorities as the business grows.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own customer onboarding, order execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and issue resolution.
* Build the processes, metrics, and playbooks needed to serve more manufacturers with a lean team.
* Work with engineering to identify which operational workflows AI agents should automate next.
* Manage supplier and freight operations, vendor relationships, and service quality.
* Hire and lead the operations team as the company grows.
* Partner with the founders on planning, finance, and company priorities.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Six to ten years of professional experience, including senior operations leadership as a Head of Operations, COO, VP or Director of Operations, or in a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team, with the ability to build processes from the ground up and stay hands-on.
* Strong numerical, systems, and process-design skills.
* Experience in CPG, food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, or related manufacturing, or at a company serving those industries, is useful.
* Freight brokerage or 3PL experience, or experience as a founder or early startup employee, is a plus.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, five days a week. Relocation within the United States is possible.

new_roles.title: Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch
new_roles.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**LOCATION:** Remote with Travel

US Valve is growing rapidly, driven by critical customer demand in data center and other high-growth markets, creating increasingly complex new product development programs with multiple manufacturing paths. The Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch will build and lead the function responsible for taking these programs from business case through stable production, whether manufactured at US Valve, at sister IDEX business units, through external supply chain partners, or through a hybrid model. The role ensures that product design, manufacturing processes, suppliers, supply chain, quality systems, and commercial launch mature together against one integrated plan.

This leader is the single point of accountability for integrated NPI execution and owns end-to-end program results, including schedule, budget, quality, supplier readiness, manufacturing readiness, launch readiness, and ramp performance. The role organizes Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Sales, Finance, BU partners, and external suppliers under one plan. The Director ensures APQP and launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections, are completed on time and to standard. Success isn't design release; it is demonstrating that the full value stream can repeatedly meet customer demand with the required quality, cost, and delivery performance.

The right leader is a builder and results driver with the technical and operational credibility to walk the factory floor, challenge supplier capacity, identify manufacturing constraints, and lead cross-functional recovery. This person establishes the PMO, sets objective gate criteria and metrics, holds functional leaders and partners accountable without direct authority, challenges unrealistic plans, and leads recovery when programs fall behind. The leader will model IDEX values of trust, team, and excellence and build a high-performing team that scales with the business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Build and Lead the Function***

* Build and lead the Program Management Office (PMO), including organizational structure, staffing plan, talent development, and succession for program and launch managers.
* Establish standard NPD governance—stage-gate/tollgate process, templates, operating cadence, and decision rights—aligned with the IDEX Operating Model.
* Define objective gate-exit criteria and recommend Go, Conditional Go, Hold, or Re-scope decisions based on demonstrated evidence.
* Own the NPD and launch portfolio; prioritize programs using 80/20 principles and align resources to the highest-value customer and growth opportunities.
* Lead executive-level business case, tollgate, and launch-readiness reviews, driving clear decisions on scope, investment, timing, and manufacturing path.

***IDEX Connected Growth and Cross-BU Leadership***

* Drive programs across multiple sister IDEX business units, leveraging IDEX connected growth strategies to share capacity, technology, capabilities, and supply chain.
* Organize and align BU partners, supply chain partners, and internal manufacturing teams into a single integrated execution plan for each program.
* Maintain one integrated critical path and one objective program status across product, supplier, tooling, manufacturing, quality, material, and customer workstreams.
* Lead make, buy, partner, intercompany, and contract manufacturing strategies, including location, capacity, Capex, tooling, staffing, and timing.
* Establish cross-BU agreements, roles, and communication cadences that ensure clear accountability for deliverables across sites and partners.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance to align program strategy with BU and IDEX growth objectives.

***Quality Management and Launch Readiness Across Supply Chain Partners***

* Drive quality management across multiple supply chain partners, sister BUs, and internal sites to ensure consistent standards from development through production.
* Ensure APQP and product launch deliverables are completed on time and to standard, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, process flow diagrams, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections.
* Partner with Quality and Supply Chain to qualify, develop, and audit suppliers and contract manufacturers, and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Lead launch-readiness and production-readiness gates, ensuring no program advances without required quality, validation, and capacity evidence.
* Separate product validation from production-rate validation; require evidence that the complete value stream can repeatedly achieve required volume, yield, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive post-launch stabilization, ensuring yield, quality, and delivery targets are met before handoff to steady-state operations.

***Advanced Manufacturing and Capacity***

* Identify and drive advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and technologies needed to meet critical customer demand and scale production.
* Drive readiness of critical processes including welding and joining, filtration media and filter manufacturing, precision machining, assembly, automation, and production test.
* Lead capacity planning and implementation of new processes, including equipment selection, CapEx justification, facility changes, validation, and ramp plans.
* Partner with equipment providers, consultants, and IDEX sites to accelerate process development and transfer best practices.
* Champion design for manufacturability, lean, and continuous improvement in all new product introductions.
* Ensure process qualification, fixtures, tooling, controls, operator readiness, capacity, and rate trials are incorporated before design freeze and production release.

***Metrics, Visibility, and Results***

* Define and own program and launch KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that provide clear leadership visibility across BUs and partners.
* Identify risks early—schedule, resource, quality, sourcing, cost, capacity, and production readiness—and drive countermeasures and recovery plans.
* Challenge unrealistic timelines, resource assumptions, and commitments; escalate decisions and support needs to executive leadership.
* Deliver regular executive updates on portfolio status, risks, decisions, and results.
* Travel domestically and internationally up to 25% to support program execution, supplier engagement, site coordination, customer needs, and equipment-provider activities.
* Perform other related duties and support additional program, PMO, or business needs as assigned.

**KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS:**

* On-time milestone and launch attainment across the NPD portfolio.
* PPAP on-time completion and first-pass approval rate across internal sites, sister BUs, and supply chain partners.
* PFMEA, DFMEA, and control plan completion prior to required gates.
* Launch quality, including first-pass yield, PPM, and escapes at launch and 90 days post-launch.
* Ramp-to-rate performance, including time to target capacity and on-time delivery to customers.
* Critical manufacturing process readiness, including qualification and demonstrated capability for welding/joining, filtration manufacturing, machining, assembly, and test as applicable.
* Program budget, Capex, and product cost performance versus business case.
* Supplier and partner quality and delivery performance on launch programs.
* New product and IDEX-connected growth revenue enabled.
* PMO team capability, staffing, and retention.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven leader who has built and scaled a PMO, NPD launch, or program management function in a manufacturing environment.
* undefined
* Deep experience with APQP and product launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, and production part qualification.
* Track record driving quality and launch execution across multiple supply chain partners, contract manufacturers, and internal sites.
* Experience identifying and implementing advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and capacity expansions to meet demanding customer ramps.
* undefined
* Demonstrated success leading across multiple business units in a matrixed organization; multi-BU or IDEX experience preferred.
* Strong business acumen in make-versus-buy, multi-site manufacturing, CapEx, tooling, cost, capacity, and risk decisions.
* Builds metrics, dashboards, and operating cadence that drive accountability and measurable results.
* Influential leader able to align executives, BU partners, and suppliers, and hold owners accountable without direct authority.
* Strong executive communicator who turns complex program information into clear decisions and actions.
* Experience with welding/joining, filtration, pneumatics, fluid handling, pumps, compressors, blowers, valves, electromechanical products, precision manufacturing, data center, thermal management, or engineered industrial components preferred.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP certification preferred; working knowledge of the IDEX Operating Model and 80/20 a plus.
* Proficient with project management tools, dashboards, and Microsoft Office applications.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations, supply chain, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of program management, NPD, manufacturing launch, quality, or operations experience, including 5+ years leading teams, with experience in industrialization, supplier development, site transfers, and multi-site manufacturing.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to move around and be still, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear.
* Employee will occasionally lift up to 35 lbs.
* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

new_roles.title: Director of Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
*Job Seekers can review the Job Applicant Privacy Policy by clicking here (http://ryder.com/job-applicant-privacy-policy) .*

**Job Description** :

**Summary**

The Director of Continuous Improvement will support the AAI (Automotive, Aerospace, and Industrial) vertical. The services are primarily warehousing operations for distribution and inbound to manufacturing operations.

This position supports the Ryder Continuous Improvement culture across the Business Unit by actively promoting and facilitating the use of continuous improvement methods to support new and existing operations.

The Director will lead a team of CI Managers/Leads across the business to influence and drive change through data driven CI, Engineering, and Automation efforts to deliver higher levels of performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. Effectively leverage data analytics, engineering methodologies, and all Ryder lean tools to enable root cause identification and elimination.

This high influence position will interface with employees at all levels and functions across the business. This individual will work directly with his/her Operational peers in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities. This position directly reports to the Group or Senior Director of CI with dotted-line reporting to the assigned Groub Director/VP of Operations (Business Unit/Vertical). This individual will work directly with his/her peers and their direct reports in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities for new and existing operations.

**Essential Functions**

* Directs continuous improvement program and oversees engineering support functions .Supervise a team of continuous improvement Managers and quality professionals. Make employment decisions (hire, promote, coach, development) and manage performance. Develop CI Engineering bench to strategically support the BU/Vertical long term requirements. Manages and assigns CI resources for multiple and complex Supply Chain projects aligned with strategic and growth initiatives. Regularly interacts with Senior Management and/or customer(s).
* Aligns CI initiatives and project objectives to business strategy and prioritizes projects accordingly; includes key stakeholders in process, as required. Facilitate strategic planning (vertical blueprinting) and tactical process improvement events. Lead cross functional team to identify improvement opportunities and works with leadership to prioritize & plan initiatives. Present to executive leadership team on status and results of continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in regular business review session with VP of Operations, SCE team and Customers . Provide regular reports of data and actions to measure progress against strategic business objectives.
* Provide training, coaching, and mentoring: must be able to translate all Ryder Business System concepts and strategic objectives to local situations and help all levels of the organization develop understanding and application of tools for sustainable business improvements. Coach business owners to use Engineering, Data Analysis and Lean methods to achieve operational excellence. Support start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications.
* Work with vertical leaders to establish continuous improvement goals, and act as a liaison with finance to build continuous improvement budgets and validating actual improvement results. Develops, deploys and maintains account plans for assigned process areas designed to continually improve service offerings through the implementation of recognized engineering, quality, lean standards, continuous improvement strategies and demonstrated best practices. Manage monthly budget review process and financial reconciliation. Interfaces with senior level management to establish standard quality communications and action oriented forums (reviewing /analyzing operational performance, deploy policies and strategies, share best practices)
* Serve as the business owner, establish and regulate the standards for Quality Management Systems based on company and/or industry standards. Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification. Facilitate regular Performance Reviews with operations leadership and monitor metrics. Develop/implement strategy to manage scope and meet customer expectations. Support business start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications. Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards. Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system. Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements. Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion
* Effective facilitation and execution of Value Stream Maps & Kaizen Events through all stages (A3 charter creation, pre-work identification and completion, delivery of results, regular follow up and follow through on sustainment). Independently identifies process gaps and recommends and leads CI Team to implement process improvement. Manage, track, and report the progress and value of the transformational activities and projects across customer accounts. Direct the assessment, development, implementation, and continuous improvement activities related to the implementation of lean processes across accounts.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards.
* Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system.
* Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements.
* Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion.
* Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Skills and Abilities**

* Microsoft Office Suite skills with emphasis on Access, Excel and PowerPoint & Visioexpert required
* Data visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) and database programming (SQL, DAX, etc.) intermediate preferred
* Expertise in developing and managing: Leader Standard Work, Visual Management Systems and Management Accountability Systems, Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S/Workplace Organization expert required
* Understanding and experience in core engineering and data analysis functions (slotting, utilization, labor planning, layouts, metrics, etc.) and warehouse design tools such as CAD (e.gAutoCAD); slotting (e.gSlot3D), Predetermined Motion and Time Systems and methods (e.gMOST); Warehouse Management Systems (e.gManhattan Scale), and Labor MgtSystems expert preferred
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management operations, data analytics, Industrial Engineering, warehouse types (ambient, temp control, warehouse layout/ design and Lean methods
* Knowledge of material handling solutions and automation types such as: powered industrial truck (PIT) applications; racking and other storage solution designs, packaging equipment; conveyor and sortation equipment; and other automation solutions (e.gAS/RS)expert required
* Knowledge of Dedicated Services and Managed Transportation Networks
* Knowledge of all available equipment types such as; dry van, temperature control, flat bed, other specialized equipment
* Transportation Design Tools ie; JDA, Appian, Network Design Tools ie; Llamasoft, Transportation Management Systems ie; JDA, OTM, , Mapping Software ie; Tableau expert required
* Knowledge working with HRM systems (e.gWorkday) and associated HR processes
* Knowledge on team member hiring/on-boardingKnowledge of goal setting and performance management/resolutionadvanced preferred

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required Engineering, Business, Supply Chain
* Master's degree preferred Supply Chain Management or Industrial Engineering
* Ten (10) years or more Fourteen (14) yrs or more in the Distribution, Warehousing and/or Manufacturing, Transportation, Supply Chain Logistics industry required
* Microsoft Office Suite skills with emphasis on Access, Excel and PowerPoint & Visio. expert required
* Data visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) and database programming (SQL, DAX, etc.) intermediate preferred
* Expertise in developing and managing: Leader Standard Work, Visual Management Systems and Management Accountability Systems, Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S/Workplace Organization expert required
* Understanding and experience in core engineering and data analysis functions (slotting, utilization, labor planning, layouts, metrics, etc.) and warehouse design tools such as CAD (e.g. AutoCAD); slotting (e.g. Slot3D), Predetermined Motion and Time Systems and methods (e.g. MOST); Warehouse Management Systems (e.g. Manhattan Scale), and Labor Mgt. Systems. expert preferred
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management operations, data analytics, Industrial Engineering, warehouse types (ambient, temp control, warehouse layout/ design and Lean methods. Knowledge of material handling solutions and automation types such as: powered industrial truck (PIT) applications; racking and other storage solution designs, packaging equipment; conveyor and sortation equipment; and other automation solutions (e.g. AS/RS). expert required
* Knowledge of Dedicated Services and Managed Transportation Networks. Knowledge of all available equipment types such as; dry van, temperature control, flat bed, other specialized equipment. Transportation Design Tools ie; JDA, Appian, Network Design Tools ie; Llamasoft, Transportation Management Systems ie; JDA, OTM, , Mapping Software ie; Tableau. expert required
* Knowledge working with HRM systems (e.g. Workday) and associated HR processes. Knowledge on team member hiring/on-boarding. Knowledge of goal setting and performance management/resolution. advanced preferred
* Lean Six Sigma, required
* American Production Inventory Control Society (APICS) and/or Supply Chain Logistics Certification is preferred
* cPMP, ISO/QMS, preferred

**Travel** - 50% - 70% (Eastern and Central time zones)

This position is remote, when you are not traveling.

Your Voice. Your Success. The Future We Build Together.

new_roles.title: Global Director, Operations & Supply Chain - Data Center Solutions
new_roles.description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

The Global Director of Operations provides strategic and functional leadership for manufacturing operations across multiple sites and regions. This role develops and executes operational strategies to deliver world-class performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction while supporting business growth and long-term competitiveness.

The Global Director leads and influences across Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Materials and Logistics, Capital and Capacity Management, and digital manufacturing. This leader drives operational excellence through the Eaton Business System, continuous improvement, integrated planning, technology enablement, and development of high-performing teams. 
 
**Essential Responsibilities:** 

* Develop and execute the global operations strategy in alignment with business objectives, annual profit plan commitments, growth priorities, and customer requirements.
* Provide strategic and functional leadership across global manufacturing operations to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead manufacturing capacity, utilization, capital investment, and footprint strategies to support current business requirements and future growth.
* Drive Integrated Operations across Manufacturing Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Materials and Logistics, Capital and Capacity Management, and SIOP/S&OE.
* Establish key performance indicators and operating rhythms to monitor operational and financial performance and drive accountability for results.
* Champion Environmental, Health and Safety and build a zero-incident culture with strong leadership and employee ownership.
* Drive a zero-defect culture through effective quality systems, disciplined root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Lead operational excellence through the Eaton Business System, lean management systems, standard work, and structured problem solving.
* Advance digital manufacturing, automation, analytics, and Industry 4.0 capabilities to improve productivity and competitiveness.
* Partner cross-functionally to support new product introductions, manufacturing readiness, product transitions, and strategic growth initiatives.
* Build organizational capability through talent assessment, succession planning, leadership development, and workforce planning.
* Lead organizational change and build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and customer expectations.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, quality, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements.
* Demonstrate leadership consistent with the Eaton Culture Model and Eaton Code of Ethics.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations/Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, supply chain, operational excellence, engineering, quality, or related functions.
* Significant plant leadership and multi-site operations management experience.
* Experience leading complex operations within a large manufacturing organization.
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing strategy, capacity planning, capital management, footprint optimization, and continuous improvement.
* Strong business and financial acumen with experience managing operational and financial performance.

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed operations within a global manufacturing organization.
* Prior profit and loss responsibility.
* Experience with lean management systems, SIOP/S&OE, MRP, ERP, and quality management systems.
* Experience with advanced manufacturing, automation, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
* Demonstrated experience leading organizational transformation and developing senior operations talent.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

The application window for this position is anticipated to close on 12/31/2026

 

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

At Eaton, we strive to provide compensation and benefits that attract, engage, and retain the best talent. This includes competitive pay and a variety of benefit programs for eligible employees. The expected annual salary range for this role is $182000 - $266000 a year. This role is also eligible for a variable incentive program. *Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.*

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Advanced Mission Partners, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Science Systems and Applications, Inc (SSAI) seeks a Director of Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across our aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, and engineering services operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing daily operations, optimizing manufacturing performance, managing resources, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products and engineering services. This position will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, improving profitability, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting the company's continued growth. 
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in aerospace and defense manufacturing, demonstrated leadership experience, and a proven ability to manage complex manufacturing operations while meeting demanding quality, cost, and delivery requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree (BS) in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in program management, project management, manufacturing operations, or engineering.
* At least 5 years of experience managing complex technical or manufacturing programs, preferably within the aerospace, defense, or electronics manufacturing industries.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations, managing budgets, and improving operational performance.
* Experience working with aerospace and defense customers, including government agencies, prime contractors, and commercial aerospace organizations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, engineering development, quality assurance, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and implementing operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience in aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing services (EMS), or precision manufacturing.
* Familiarity with printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), electronic systems integration, and aerospace manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, and applicable aerospace quality requirements.
* Experience with government contracts, including FAR, DFARS, ITAR, and EAR requirements.
* Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM), program financial forecasting, and cost control methodologies.
* Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and project management software, such as Microsoft Project or equivalent tools.
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), production transitions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation, process optimization, and production scalability.

**EOE, including disability/vets**

***Physical Requirements:*** *While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and use hands to touch, handle or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee frequently is required to talk and hear and occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.*

new_roles.title: Director of Production Planning
new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Production Planning leads the enterprise production planning and scheduling operating system across Karman's manufacturing operations. In this role, you will transform customer demand and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) outputs into executable production plans, capacity strategies, and recovery actions that support on-time delivery and predictable execution while providing visibility into risks, constraints, and opportunities across the manufacturing network.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads production planning, master scheduling, and finite-capacity planning across Karman manufacturing sites and value streams.
* Translates customer demand, backlog, and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) outputs into achievable production schedules with clear priorities, constraints, and recovery plans.
* Establishes planning standards and key performance indicators (KPIs) for schedule adherence, on-time delivery, past-due backlog, work-in-process (WIP) aging, capacity utilization, and plan attainment.
* Partners with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to align labor, equipment, tooling, and process capacity with production requirements.
* Coordinates with Supply Chain to identify material shortages, supplier constraints, and outside-processing risks before they affect production performance.
* Leads schedule recovery and re-baselining efforts when demand, material availability, quality issues, or capacity changes create delivery risk.
* Ensures enterprise resource planning (ERP), material requirements planning (MRP), and planning data are accurate, timely, and aligned with approved operating plans.
* Develops planners and schedulers while building a high-accountability planning organization.
* Provides executive visibility into delivery risk, capacity gaps, staffing needs, and critical decisions required to protect customer commitments.
* Improves end-to-end SIOP, planning, scheduling, and production-control processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of production planning, master scheduling, operations planning, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing planning, scheduling, or production-control teams.
* Demonstrated experience with ERP, MRP, master production schedules, capacity planning, and material requirements planning.
* Strong analytical skills and experience leading cross-functional delivery-recovery plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, space, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience with SIOP, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Power BI, or advanced manufacturing analytics.
* Knowledge of AS9100 and configuration-controlled manufacturing environments.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently communicates and works with employees in office and manufacturing environments.
* Frequently stands, walks, and uses a computer; occasionally bends, reaches, or moves throughout production areas as required by the role.
* The essential functions of this position must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Special Mentions**

* Frequent (25–50%) travel may be required to support Karman manufacturing sites.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

new_roles.title: Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation
new_roles.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.
* **Advance manufacturing transformation:** Lead strategy and governance for assigned initiatives in digital Lean, connected worker, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacityoptimization. Establish prioritization, pilot criteria, stage gates, value-realization requirements and scalable deployment standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain Strategy, Digital/IT and Finance.
* **Deliver measurable business value:** Translate operational losses and capability gaps into an enterprise improvement portfolio. Connect HLPS maturity to safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, productivity and people outcomes, partnering with Finance to validate benefits.
* **Lead and develop the team:** Guide Lean Program Leads and transformation and technical resources, focusing support on the network’s highest-value opportunities.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business or related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

 

**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering or Operational Excellence, including 5+ years leading leaders, multi-site programs or enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation.
* Demonstrated success designing, deploying or materially advancing Lean, Total Productive Maintenance, or a manufacturing operating system across multiple sites.
* Strong knowledge of Lean management systems, TPM, Daily Management, structured problem solving, loss analysis, asset reliability and capability development.
* Proven ability to influence Plant Managers and senior cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, coaching and change-leadership skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent demonstrated experience preferred.
* Experience in automated or capital-intensive manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Previous leadership of a manufacturing site, major production operation or enterprise or multi-site Operational Excellence transformation strongly preferred.
* Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, or other regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health begin on Day 1.
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

 

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $166,400 to $208,000 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. In addition to a market-competitive base salary, our Total Rewards package includes performance‑based incentives and a comprehensive, competitive benefits package designed to support overall physical, mental, and financial well‑being (as applicable). Learn more about Hershey’s benefits and all the resources Hershey provides to support our employees’ physical, emotional, and financial well‑being by visiting the Hershey Digital Employee Experience at www.askHRbenefits.hersheys.com

The Hershey Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The policy of The Hershey Company is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
The Hershey Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority/Female/Disabled/Protected Veterans. You may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our online application process as a result of a disability. 
You can request an accommodation via phone or email.To request an accommodation via phone, please call +1 877-804-1794 and leave a voicemail with your contact information. You may also email a request for accommodation to ApplicationHelp@hersheys.com. Please be sure to include “Accommodation Needed” in the subject line. This will ensure that your email is routed to the appropriate contact who will handle your request.

new_roles.title: Director of Production
new_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Delta Galil USA, Inc. is a global manufacturer and marketer of branded and private label apparel products for men, women and children. Since its inception in 1975, the company has continually endeavored to create products that follow a body-before-fabric philosophy, placing equal emphasis on comfort, aesthetics and quality. Delta Galil develops innovative seamless apparel, including bras, shapewear and socks; intimate apparel for women; underwear for men, including under its owned brands Schiesser, Eminence, Organic Basics and Athena; babywear, activewear, sleepwear and loungewear, including under its owned P.J. Salvage and Delta brands. Delta Galil also designs, develops, markets and sells branded denim and apparel under the brand 7 For All Mankind®, and ladies’ and kids’ apparel under the brand Splendid®. In addition, it sells its products under brand names licensed to the company, including adidas, Wolford, Wilson, Columbia, Tommy Hilfiger and others.

**Position Overview**

At Delta Galil, great product only matters if it reaches the shelf at the right cost, at the right quality and on time. As Director, Production & Sourcing, you’ll make that happen. You’ll own Sourcing and Production for your programs, from the first seasonal projection to the moment goods land at our Distribution Center, steering a global network of mills, factories and overseas offices that supply some of the biggest names in mass-market retail.

This is a role with real levers. You’ll negotiate the costs that shape the department’s margin, decide where programs are placed and how capacity is allocated, and lead the cross-functional team through every approval milestone, from BOM handoff to TOP. You’ll partner every day with Design, Planning and our Domestic and Offshore QA teams, and you’ll be the person everyone looks to when a delivery is at risk.

You’ll thrive here if you’re a natural negotiator and a hands-on leader who knows a garment down to its cost components, stays calm when a test fails or a vessel slips, and gets energy from turning a complex calendar into on-time deliveries.

**Key Responsibilities**

Sourcing, Costing & Vendor Strategy

* Share seasonal projections with mills and factories early, locking in key delivery dates and a generic TNA well ahead of order placement.
* Lead program-level cost negotiations that drive best costs and help the department meet or beat seasonal margin goals.
* Build and grow a strong vendor matrix that supports the business’s long-term needs.
* Place programs with overseas mills, factories and offices on time, with program-specific TNAs, the right capacity allocation and production plans that hit contracted deliveries.

Production Execution & Approvals

* Lead the cross-functional team through program TNAs, driving approvals from completed BOM handoff through color and components, fit, pre-production, testing and TOP.
* Work with stakeholders to resolve approval issues and testing failures quickly, escalating to leadership when needed.
* Assess production issues for delivery impact and lead cross-functional decisions on quality levels and ship-mode changes to protect customer deliveries.

Planning, Capacity & Delivery

* Partner with the Planning team to support the business at the right stock levels.
* Own and communicate monthly program capacity plans to mills and factories, flagging loading or capacity risks early.
* Keep POs current in the system, hold factories to timely bookings and approve vessel schedules that line up with customer deliveries.
* Build and maintain delivery reports for weekly team review.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Partner with Domestic and Offshore QA, sharing planned program allocation before placement.
* Champion critical QA steps before, during and at the end of production so product arrives at the Distribution Center free of quality issues and every customer order ships on time.
* Work with management to improve process flow and roll out new initiatives.

 
Requirements: 
 

* Minimum years of apparel experience across Product Development, Production, QA and Testing.
* Experience supplying a big-box, mass-market retailer such as Target or Walmart.
* Cut-and-sew knits experience (activewear strongly preferred).
* Deep knowledge of manufacturing, testing and quality control, including fabrics, trims and garment cost components (YY, CM, AU).
* A proven team leader with exceptional negotiation and problem-solving skills with factories and material suppliers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to connect with factories, suppliers and internal teams at every level.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-up, a sense of urgency and the ability to juggle multiple projects and teams.
* Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) and proficiency in Word and Outlook.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Activewear, intimates, loungewear, or knits experience.
* CPM and SMV knowledge, with a thorough understanding of cost component breakdowns.
* Experience traveling overseas to mills and factories.

**This is a hybrid role, with 4 days in our NJ office.**

**PAY RATE: $150,000/yr-$170,000/yr**

At Delta Galil, we strive to hire and nurture amazing talent. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to experience, specialized skills, and internal alignment.

DIVERSITY VISION STATEMENT:

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment that welcomes and values the differences among all of our associates, customers, suppliers, and the communities in which we live and conduct business. We are an equal employment opportunity for minorities, females, protected veterans, and the disabled.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and treating our associates and applicants without discrimination based on their race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

 
Hybrid position:
 
Hybrid 
 
Company Benefits: 
 

As a Delta Galil Associate, you’ll be part of a global fashion company that values innovation, craftsmanship, and people. We’re committed to offering comprehensive and competitive benefits that reflect our culture of care, creativity, and collaboration — but most importantly, benefits that fit you.

Our diverse range of programs is designed to support your total well-being — empowering you to make the best choices for yourself, your loved ones, and your lifestyle.

Below are a few of the benefits available to our Associates:

* Multi-brand merchandise discount, including Splendid, 7 For All Mankind, and PJ Salvage
* Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance, as well as Basic Life/Voluntary Life/Disability/Critical Illness
* Financial Wellness: 401(k) Retirement Program with Company match and 529 College Savings Plan, as well as Tax-Advantage Health & Transit Accounts
* Personal and sick time off, vacation time, floating days, and company-observed holidays
* Paid Volunteer Time Off to dedicate your skills and time towards charitable activities
* From weekly breakfasts and monthly milestone celebrations to leadership-led panels, and, team-building events, we offer plenty of fun ways to connect—both in person and virtually
